lines.zh: 我小跑着穿过蕨丛，很轻。
lines.en: I trot through the ferns, light on my feet.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，沿地面快走。
lines.en: I keep low and scurry along the ground.

lines.zh: 我四足一起一落，动作很短。
lines.en: All four feet move in short, quick beats.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛带刺的植物。
lines.en: I go round a thorny clump.
I head toward the marsh.
I walk and keep looking up.

lines.zh: 我踩过湿泥，脚印很清楚。
lines.en: I cross the wet mud and my prints show.
Every few steps I stop to listen.
I slip along the wood's edge.
I choose the thin grass to walk on.
I stay neither close to my herd nor far.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴压低，快速通过。
lines.en: I keep my tail low and hurry across.

lines.zh: 我踩上石头，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I step onto stone with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我留下小脚印。
lines.en: My small prints stay in the marsh mud.
I crouch with my head up, listening.
When the grass stirs, I twitch.
I blink my eyes slowly.
I tuck my forepaws to my chest.
I sniff the mud underfoot.

lines.zh: 远处有点声音，我屏住气。
lines.en: A noise far off and I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我身体差不多只有半格宽。
lines.en: My body is barely half a block wide.
I hide in the leaf shadows.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸脖子，看看周围。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to look around.
I have found nothing.
I chew the leaf in my mouth lightly.

lines.zh: 我把重心放低，随时能跑。
lines.en: I keep my weight low, ready to run.

lines.zh: 太阳移了，我跟着挪了一点。
lines.en: The sun has moved and I shift with it.

lines.zh: 我盯着土里的一处，没动。
lines.en: I stare at a spot in the soil without moving.
My head snaps up to look at you.
You are too big, so I shrink back.
I did not run, but my legs are shaking.

lines.zh: 我打量你，判断你有多危险。
lines.en: I size you up to judge the danger.
I watch you through the grass blades.
I squeeze a note from my throat.
You smell of mud.
I want to leave but dare not turn.
I have not moved, and neither have you.

lines.zh: 我朝草丛那边挪了一点。
lines.en: I edge a little toward the grass.
I squeal and dart into the grass.

lines.zh: 疼得我在地上打了个滚。
lines.en: The pain rolls me over on the ground.
My legs give and I flatten out.
I scrape along on the hurt leg.

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼，它还在。
lines.en: I glance back; it is still there.
My snout stings and my sight blurs.
I change direction and run hard.
I cut that into my tail bone.
Small as I am, I cannot take many.

lines.zh: 你一扬叶子，我就抬头了。
lines.en: You lift the leaves and my head comes up.

lines.zh: 我小心地靠近，一步一停。
lines.en: I approach carefully, a step at a time.
This is tender.

lines.zh: 我咬一口嫩叶，立刻退开。
lines.en: One bite of the tender leaf, then straight back.
I keep watching your other hand.
Only when you hold still do I dare closer.
I eat quickly, and I am afraid.
Done chewing, I look up at you.
This is better than what grows wild.
I carry it back into the grass.
The knock puts me on my back.
I scramble up and bolt.
Your boot touches me like a wall.
I dodged half a step too late.

lines.zh: 撞完我缩在草里不敢动。
lines.en: After the hit I freeze in the grass.
I retreat a long way before stopping.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖被撞歪的身子。
lines.en: I shake my knocked-about body straight.
I have not recovered yet.
I will not come close again.

lines.zh: 我们鼻子碰鼻子，很快就分开。
lines.en: We touch noses and part quickly.
It runs one circle around me.
I follow it into the ferns.
We lower our heads to eat side by side.
When it moves, I startle.
I bump its head.
We prick our ears at that side together.
It went far and I did not follow.
We doze in one heap.
It left first and I stayed.
I pin it with a forepaw before biting.
I pick up a small fruit.
It fell out of my mouth.
I hide it under a leaf.
I chew with my eyes on both sides.
I tuck a mouthful in my cheek.
This one is a little sour.
I spit it out; I dare not eat it.
The grass rustles and I freeze.
I nail that side in my sight.
I press my head as low as it goes.
It is too big; I only dare watch its feet.
I take one step toward the grass first.
One move from it and I am ready to run.
I hear it snap a branch.
My heart is pounding loudly.
I have my escape route picked.
One turn and I am gone.
I make myself smaller.
I give a small call.
I retreat toward cover.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着它，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on it and dare not blink.
It circles and I shift.
I shrink back into the grass.
It takes a step, I give one.
I press my body to the ground.
It stops and I hold.
I am reckoning how far I can run.
The moment it lowers its head, I run.
Tail trembling, I edge toward the ferns.

lines.zh: 它还在蕨丛外，我没敢动。
lines.en: It's still past the ferns; I don't dare move.

lines.zh: 我贴在泥地上，一动不动。
lines.en: I press to the mud and do not stir.

lines.zh: 它每换一次位置，我也换。
lines.en: Each time it moves, so do I.
I edge toward the nearest fern.
Its shadow has reached me.
I wait for it to leave first.
I jump and bite it once.
I bump it, with little force.
That bite caught hide.
Having bitten, I dive into the grass.
One swing of its hand and I retreat.
I bite a second time.
My legs shake and I am still standing.
I am no good in a fight.
I shrink back into the leaf shadows.
I bite its toes.

lines.zh: 这一下几乎没造成什么。
lines.en: That barely did anything.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，很快就后悔。
lines.en: I bite and hold, and regret it quickly.

lines.zh: 我从蕨丛里钻出来，先看四周。
lines.en: I push out of the ferns and check around.
This mud is soft. Perfect.
I raise my head and listen a while.

lines.zh: 同伴在我旁边叫了一声。
lines.en: A herdmate calls beside me.
I shift toward the marsh.
I scuff a few prints.
This place is heavy with moisture.
I hide in the leaf shadows.
I move slowly into the grass.
The water is near here.
The moment I arrive, all goes quiet.
I keep low and hurry off.
I stop at a ditch.
The grass here can hide me.
The moment I land I dive under the leaves.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我翻滚着躲。
lines.en: Fire sears my back and I roll away.

lines.zh: 我落地翻了个身，半天才起来。
lines.en: I land and roll over, slow to rise.
The blast throws me through the air.
Something sharp lodges in my hind leg.

lines.zh: 一股冷意把我压在地上。
lines.en: Cold force presses me to the ground.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我整只僵住。
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下没地，我一路掉下去。
lines.en: No ground below and I fall away.
